يستشرفوا (form X)
# يَسْتَشْرِفُوا (yastašrifū) /jas.taʃ.ri.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشْرَفَ (istašrafa)
# يُسْتَشْرَفُوا (yustašrafū) /jus.taʃ.ra.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشْرَفَ (istašrafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
